title: Mars Rovers and Landers
description: Mars rovers and notable landers with their agency, launch year, and mission status.

results.name: Sojourner
results.mission: First rover on Mars, part of the Mars Pathfinder mission.

results.name: Spirit (MER-A)
results.mission: Mars Exploration Rover that studied rocks and soil for signs of past water.

results.name: Opportunity (MER-B)
results.mission: Mars Exploration Rover that operated for nearly 15 years and found evidence of past water.

results.name: Curiosity
results.mission: Mars Science Laboratory rover exploring Gale Crater for habitability.

results.name: Perseverance
results.mission: Rover searching for signs of ancient life and collecting samples in Jezero Crater.

results.name: Zhurong
results.mission: China's first Mars rover, part of the Tianwen-1 mission.

results.name: InSight
results.mission: Stationary lander that studied the deep interior and seismology of Mars.

results.name: Phoenix
results.mission: Lander that confirmed subsurface water ice in the Martian arctic.

results.name: Viking 1
results.mission: First lander to successfully operate on the Martian surface.
